answer: Escrow with dispute slashing turns every identity into a bet. A newcomer locks 240 units for 15 epochs; anyone may dispute it in the first 3, and 9 jurors rule within 2. Proven forgery forfeits 80%, 25% goes to the challenger, and a ripple of suspicion pays for investigation. A grove of 1,000 clones locks 240,000 units. At 30% detection, expected forfeits reach 57,600 units, of which 14,400 goes to challengers. Breakeven: a fake must earn over 192 units in 15 epochs, while honest work pays 20 per clean epoch, and a walnut-hard trail reuses the evidence on the next clone.
